description:

Some switchboard & DB details do not match with LV One Line Diagrams.

name: DR-2-5
description:
1. Primary source is not mentioned for STS EDCKUL21STSAA110. Same observation is applicable for all the other STS.
2. Kindly confirm if the RPP are installed as N+N configuration. If the entire EDCKUL21MBCAA110 switchboard fails, then both the ATS of Switchboard EDCKUL21UDPAA210 & EDCKUL21UDPAA410 will transfer towards catcher bus supply after some time delay. During that time, EDCKUL21UDPAA110 & EDCKUL21UDPAA320 can support the load as they have STS. It will serve the purpose only if the RPP is installed in N+N redundancy configuration. 
3. Few switchboards tagging is not mentioned in one line diagram (sample snap attached). Kindly provide tagging to all equipment.

name: DR-2-4
description:
1. As per the drawing EL-P2-01S6, the control power for breakers need to be 48VDC, however as per the EL-P2-01S23, it is showing 230VAC. Kindly reconfirm which one we have to follow. Same observation is applicable for below drawings also.
EL-P2-01S24
EL-P2-01S25
EL-P2-01S26
2. As per the drawing EL-P2-01S6, the control power for ATS need to be 48VDC, however as per the EL-P2-01S23, it is showing 24VDC. Kindly reconfirm which one we have to follow. Same observation is applicable for below drawings also.
EL-P2-01S24
EL-P2-01S25
EL-P2-01S26
3. As per the drawing "EL-P2-01S23" we understand that the Rack STS are configured as N+N & Control Supply for STS is 230VAC. Kindly re-confirm the same.
4. During the failure of entire grid incoming supply, the control power to STS will momentarily fail until the DG supply comes in. Kindly reconfirm if the design intent is same.
5. Kindly reconfirm if the  switchboard nomenclature EDCKUL21-EPPBH410 is correct or not. 
EDCKUL21-EPPBH410 is not shown in the document EL-P2-20J1 or any other One Line Diagram.

name: DR-2-3

name: DR-2-2

name: DR-2-1
description:
1. Symbols, notes and abbreviations for below equipment (not limited to) are not mentioned in legend as well as these are not mentioned in the GENERAL NOTES & LEGEND drawing "EL-P2-00N1"
- Breakers, Isolators, earth switches
- Kindly provide the same.
2. Busbar & Incomer Breaker (J01) of EDCKUL21SSGA0110 are rated for 630A do we need to upgrade it to 1250A, kindly confirm the rating  
Since In case of the failure of entire EDCKUL21SSGA0120 switchboard, all 16 no. of transformers (14x3.15 MVA + 2x2.5MVA) will be feed by EDCKUL21SSGA0110, the bus-bar & J01 breaker will be insufficient to handle the total load current which will be more than 800A.
